subject: zoology
question_text: Why is adolescence considered a vulnerable phase?

verification.note: Sourced from the Sri Chaitanya Junior Fastrack zoology section (book p.43, SAQ 44). Zoology holds only ONE source book — the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no zoology board paper is in the corpus — so the two-book union check and the back-test are both structurally impossible for this card; 'not checked' does NOT mean 'checked and clean'. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it.

steps.label: What adolescence is
lines: Adolescence is the period of life between about
It is the bridge between childhood and
adulthood, and during it a child becomes mature.
steps.why: The answer needs a fixed span before it can argue anything, and the phrase 'bridge between childhood and adulthood' is the sentence the examiner looks for first.
common_mistakes: Giving the wrong age span. The syllabus gives about 12 to 18 years.
Starting with the drugs. Define the phase first.
steps.memory_tip: Twelve to eighteen: the bridge from child to adult.
steps.margin_note: Two lines. The age span and the word bridge carry this mark.

steps.label: Changes in this phase
lines: Many biological changes take place in this
period. The body grows quickly and the
Many behavioural changes take place at the same
time. The adolescent wants an identity of his or
her own, is curious about new things, and is
strongly influenced by friends of the same age.
The mind and the body are therefore changing
steps.why: Vulnerability comes from two kinds of change happening at once, so the answer must show the body changes and the behaviour changes side by side rather than one alone.
common_mistakes: Writing only about the body. The behavioural changes carry half of this mark.
Writing that adolescents are careless. Describe the changes, not a judgement of the person.
steps.memory_tip: Two changes at once: the body matures and the behaviour changes in the same few years.
steps.margin_note: Two groups of change, one short block each. This is the biggest part: two marks.

steps.label: Why it is vulnerable
lines: Because so much mental and psychological
development happens in this short period, an
adolescent can be led easily into the use of
For this reason adolescence is said to be a
vulnerable phase in the life of an individual.
steps.why: The question word is 'why', so the last step has to close the argument: fast change plus outside influence is what makes this phase easy to damage.
common_mistakes: Ending without using the word vulnerable.
Blaming the adolescent. The answer explains the phase, not the person.
steps.memory_tip: Fast change plus strong influence equals a phase that is easy to damage.
steps.margin_note: One closing sentence that uses the word vulnerable. Do not add new facts here.

insider_note: The examiner marks the closing sentence: the answer must end by saying WHY the phase is vulnerable, not merely describe adolescence.
